record.hypothesis: A 1,200,000-sample integer signal was filtered with a 129-tap FIR. A 6,000-sample edit produced Δx; only hΔx was recomputed and added to the cached output. Result. The patched output is exactly equal to a full recomputation. The correction support is 6,128 samples, including the FIR tail; omitting that tail fails the oracle. Median patch time was 1.061 ms versus 90.474 ms full, or 85.3× in this sparse-edit corpus. Boundary. This identity is for linear time-invariant filtering. Nonlinear/stateful effects, adaptive filters, compressors, limiters, reverbs with external state, format changes, and resampling need separate dependency/state analysis.
